race.comment: THE DEMOCRAT (9) maintained his good form last time out, coming from this row and scoring by a neck at this venue to give him two wins and three seconds from his last six starts. Drawn to enjoy an economical run and might sweat on the sprint lane. With even luck he is good enough to take out a race like this. KRISTYSGIRL (2) drew wider and worked last start and was good when runner-up after racing parked here prior. Should get her chance from this draw. SPRING DELIGHT (1) should be at his peak for this after three outings off a spell. Came from the back row to finish midfield in each of those outings. The ace draw gives him every chance to show his best. TUFFASOLDBOOTS (10) chased along the sprint lane when beaten 4.7 metres last week and had recorded a string of top-four finishes prior. Draws on the back line but if things go his way he can win a race of this calibre. PIRANI PRINCESS (5) is heading the right way, improving last time out to place.
